name: nimbusimage
description: Skills for working with NimbusImage scientific imaging datasets through the nimbusimage Python API

interface.longDescription: Connect to NimbusImage, retrieve image data, manage annotations, run workers, compute measurements, export results, and share datasets through the Python API.
defaultPrompt: Connect to my NimbusImage server and list my datasets.
Analyze annotations in a NimbusImage dataset.
Run an image-analysis worker and export the results.
